This is a stale-hobbyiqCardId data-quality defect, much larger than the 2 sample docs, NOT a sales-repoint-list problem: the sale is already at the right address by cardId, sales-at-id's own dual query just also matches it on the stale hobbyiqCardId. No lane found in this repo patches hobbyiqCardId by an explicit list (see the PR body's proposal). This is why 92 of 153 refused rows still show sales present after this repoint chain runs, and are correctly held out of this retire list rather than incorrectly retired.
